svg.title: Key to the setup and deployment diagrams
svg.desc: One shared key for every setup and deployment diagram (the deployment patterns, the Chasm Crossing and Whispering Grove details, the Appendix A and B maps and the 36 Core Scenario maps): one swatch per glyph, pattern, line type and status convention, drawn by the same functions as the diagrams.
svg.text: Key to the setup and deployment diagrams
A range: any value in it

text.tspan: North is drawn at the top. The Setup Roll-off winner designates the North edge before setup; North and South are the

svg.text: short battlefield edges and East and West the long ones, even on a square battlefield (10.1).

text.tspan: The battlefield, zones and stated distances are drawn to scale; markers are enlarged, and Large and Huge Monsters are drawn

svg.text: at their 2"×2" and 3"×3" footprints. Distances are measured between closest points, except from a centre or origin where the rule says

text.tspan: Scattered terrain is drawn as a few representative pieces; the printed counts and the 10.6 scaling stay in the scenario text.

svg.text: Group numbers are the scenario's own. Hidden contents (face-down markers) are never drawn.

text.tspan: A solid marker or zone with a distance symbol is one position that meets the printed limit; only the battlefield, zone

svg.text: depths and stated distances are exact. Grey dashed pieces show one legal arrangement of something the rules leave open. Letters A
and B name the drawn zones; where a scenario assigns the parties by die roll, the zones do not say who is which.

text.tspan: A ? tag marks an element the scenario text does not place, such as an arrival or escape edge it never names. It

svg.text: is listed under the map with a short note and is not drawn on the battlefield; the scenario text governs.

text.tspan: , 10.1 step 11 applies: the Setup Roll-off winner chooses the edge or corner zone and the other party takes

svg.text: the opposite one; zones are 6" deep or 8"×8" corners, marked "(default)" on a map, and parties alternate placing Heroes, starting with
the party that lost the Roll-off.
